summary: NextNav Inc. filed an 8-K on June 15, 2026, announcing the redemption of all outstanding 5.00% Senior Secured Convertible Notes due 2028. The redemption date is June 25, 2026, with a redemption price of 100% of principal plus accrued interest, payable in cash. Holders may convert notes into common stock at 79.6178 shares per $1,000 principal prior to the second trading day before the redemption date. This mandatory redemption reduces debt and potential dilution, effectively a capital return event. Watch for conversion decisions; if holders choose cash, it indicates a preference for liquidity over equity exposure.
